market_note: Marketplace prices are set by hosts and change minute to minute. Published figure is the median per-GPU price of verified, rentable, on-demand offers with the exact VRAM shown, plus the lowest offer and offer count. Models with fewer than 5 such offers are not published (A100 PCIe 80GB had 1 at the 09:17 EDT check; H100 SXM had 4 earlier).
